--Wait for ODW Refresh -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @var INT, @db_state INT
SET @var = 1

WHILE @var<=8	--Max wait 4 hours (8 x 30 min)
BEGIN
	SELECT @db_state = [state] FROM sys.databases WHERE [name] = 'ODW'		--State 0 = ONLINE 
	--Wait if Database is not Online----------------------------------------------------------------------
	IF @db_state !=0
		WAITFOR DELAY '00:30';	--Wait for Additional 30 minutes
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Wait if tables can't be accessed------------------------------------------------------------
			IF (OBJECT_ID('ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER') IS NULL)
			WAITFOR DELAY '00:30';	--Wait for Additional 30 minutes
		END
	SET @var = @var + 1
END

--Wait for CAREADVANCE_DM 8AM Refresh to complete-------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @var INT, @db_state INT

--A. Run after 8:45AM-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF CONVERT(time(0), GETDATE()) <= CONVERT(time(0), '08:45:00')
BEGIN
	--Wait for 08:45AM
	WAITFOR TIME '08:45';
END

--B. Max wait 2 hours (4 x 30 min)------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET @var = 1
WHILE @var<=4
BEGIN
	SELECT @db_state = [state] FROM sys.databases WHERE [name] = 'CAREADVANCE_DM'		--State 0 = ONLINE 
	--C. Wait if Database is not Online-------------------------------------------------------------------
	IF @db_state !=0
		WAITFOR DELAY '00:30';	--Wait for Additional 30 minutes
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			--D. Wait if tables can't be accessed---------------------------------------------------------
			IF ((OBJECT_ID('[CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_MEMBER_HRA]') IS NULL) OR (OBJECT_ID('[CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_HRA]') IS NULL))
			WAITFOR DELAY '00:30';	--Wait for Additional 30 minutes
		END
	SET @var = @var + 1
END
